create_fp8_recipe_kwargs: create a GaudiTERecipeKwargs instance to configure FP8 mixed precision training with transformer-engine
customize_fp8_format: customize the fp8_format field to E5M2 or HYBRID in GaudiTERecipeKwargs for FP8 training
configure_amax_computation: configure the amax_compute_algo and amax_history_len fields in GaudiTERecipeKwargs for scaling factor computation
set_scaling_factor_interval: set the interval and margin fields in GaudiTERecipeKwargs to control scaling factor recomputation frequency
review_post_init_validation: review the GaudiTERecipeKwargs post_init validation that checks fp8_format and amax_compute_algo values
